svg.title: Anionic polymerisation mechanism of styrene
svg.desc: Initiation by n-butyl lithium adding to styrene, propagation by carbanion addition giving living chains, and deliberate termination with a proton source, with full curved arrows.
svg.text: 1. Initiation: the carbanion Bu− attacks the CH2 end of the C=C bond
2. Propagation: carbanion end adds monomer; no termination step
3. 'Living' chains stay active until a terminating agent is added
Or add a second monomer → block copolymer (e.g. SBS); CO2 → –COOH end group; ethylene oxide → –OH end group.
Needs electron-withdrawing groups (styrene, butadiene, acrylonitrile, MMA); dry, oxygen-free, aprotic medium.
